text:
ravi: Partner asked for a "provisional quota buckets" feature so they can show customers a live remaining quota number in their portal. they want it to respect marketplace entitlements + pending provisional usage.
nora: propose we expose a /partners/{id}/quota-buckets webhook that sends per-customer buckets: allocated, used_authoritative, used_provisional, remaining_estimate, and a confidence score. send on change or daily snapshot.
lucas: important: differentiate authoritative ledger usage (finalized) vs provisional (estimated/backfills). include fields: source='ledger'|'provisional', generated_at, window_start, window_end.
ravi: also partner asked for soft rate cap guidance: they want a ratecap_hint that suggests when to start throttling client SDKs to avoid an overage. e.g., ratecap_hint: "reduce_by_pct": 15.
gina: security + UX notes: include HMAC signature header, and include a human_readable_field with short guidance like "Estimate: finalization may move by +/- 3% due to backfills".
marketplace-bot: Task created MP-4999 provision-quota-bucket-webhook (owner: nora).
nora: sample webhook payload we can use in spec and SDKs:
```json
{"customer_id":"cust-789","period":"2026-08","buckets":[{"sku":"api-embed","allocated":1000000,"used_authoritative":720000,"used_provisional":742500,"remaining_estimate":257500,"confidence":0.82,"source":"provisional","generated_at":"2026-08-24T05:12:00Z","ratecap_hint":{"reduce_by_pct":10}}],"notes":"provisional values update as backfills arrive; ledger is final"}
```
ravi: cadence: send webhook on >1% change to remaining_estimate or once daily for low-change customers. partners can opt-in to hourly.
lucas: policy: no auto-credit based solely on provisional; credits only after ledger confirms and dispute window closes. include dispute_url in webhook.
gina: action items: nora -> spec + security headers; lucas -> ledger tagging for authoritative usage; ravi -> partner opt-in flow + docs; gina -> update partner T&Cs blurb.
ravi: i'll ping ACME PO after spec draft. thanks all. :thumbsup:
